title: motion-studio starter (3 s demo)

beats.action: UI card assembles with elastic pop, headline words punch in (serif + sans)
cursor glides in toward the button
cursor clicks button: squash, ring, flare, chromatic spike, card turns neon
torn-paper wipe into dark-sky neon scene
animated split screen opens, three panels
kinetic sign-off line, grain + bloom hold

notes: Every visual change has a cursor action or beat behind it. Cuts are on the 0.5 s grid (120 BPM).
